card.name: The word machine before its noun
card.fires_on: The word "machine" (or the start of "machinations") in general web text, especially right before a following noun like vision, gun, learning or translation.

modes.label: Machine as modifier
modes.description: "machine" used as an adjective-like first part of a compound such as machine vision, machine learning, machine translation.
modes.example: <<Machine>> vision systems are commonly used in inspection applications

modes.label: Machine guns
modes.description: "machine" right before "guns" in talk of weapons.

modes.label: Machine as a thing
modes.description: "machine" as a standalone noun for a device or mechanical contrast to humans.
modes.example: He had created a<< machine>> that would spiral the freezing cold weather out

card.writes: It pushes toward word endings that complete compounds like gun or yard, and away from endings like machines or machine-related suffixes.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "machine" when more of a compound, like machine gun or machine vision, is about to follow.
